r13_contract.comparisonModel: The acceptance criterion for designs is that the combined stresses from bending and shear, when using the von Mises yield criterion, are lower than the yield point sigmay. When the direct calculation is based on beam theory, the allowable shear stress must be no larger than 0.9*tauy, where tauy = sigmay/sqrt3.

test_cases.rationale: Von-Mises combined stress is below yield and the derived yield shear stress is correct; beam-theory branch is inactive.
Beam-theory allowable shear is exactly the permitted 0.9 tau_y boundary.
Beam-theory allowable shear is below the 0.9 tau_y limit.
Combined bending/shear stress equals the yield point; the source requires it to be lower.
Combined bending/shear stress exceeds the yield point.
Derived yield shear stress is inconsistent with sigma_y/sqrt(3).
Beam-theory branch is active but allowable shear stress is missing.
Combined stress uses the wrong unit.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
